title: 第十二章 暴露第十三章 交易
content_zh:
，，！
见叶钟鸣一脸严肃的看着自己他就知道自己刚刚太激进了，引起了对方的怀疑。
不得不感叹，果然能成为主角的人，智力都一直在线。
即使是在他们还没成长起来之前，也没那么简单，至少心智是异于常人。
“第一，我对你没有恶意，第二，我救了你两次，你现在手上的恢复品也是我的。
你拿枪指着我，不好吧！”
微笑的看向对方，王长乐要试一试这个人到底是不是和设定中一样，这对他后续的规划很重要。
“这里也不是谈话的地方，在战斗结束之后，我会去找你的，叶钟鸣，叶老大。”
叶钟鸣闻言慢慢放下了枪，他心下稍安，抛出了提议。
“你果然认识我！
好，我会等着你。”
叶钟鸣见眼前似乎笃定他不敢开枪的少年，心中却燃起了一团火，这种失控感，让他懊恼！
生命精华化作一抹流光，没入了叶钟鸣体内，不过片刻，他体表的伤势就全部愈合了。
带着复杂的目光看了一眼王长乐后，大步向着商场外走去。
废了九牛二虎之力，他终于收集好了尖角，还有部分的皮肉。
扫了眼满地打滚却不敢发出哀嚎声的龙套们，很贴心的扔了个扩音器。
“救命啊，救命啊，快来救救我！”
嘹亮的呼救声在商场里回响着，传出去很远很远，也引来了很多的丧尸。
一时间，惨叫混杂着求救声，不绝于耳。
抹杀敌人的希望，是对自己最大的保护，不论这个敌人多么弱小！

眺望远方近50米的铁索囚徒，正在被人用火箭筒围攻，他顿时就知道自己耗费的时间有点多了，错过了最佳的埋伏点。
根据植物的反馈，迅速地确定了方向，马不停蹄的向着湖畔广场赶去。
那里是最终的决战地点，也会是他最后的机会！
在丧尸和怪物的冲击下，军队的枪炮威力发挥到了最大，火力覆盖之下大幅度的压制了怪兽的活动半径。
同时，也极大的限制了他的行进路线。
为了绕开怪物和火力点，以保证自身的安全，他不得不绕远路。
遥望远处莹绿色火焰怪和交战的水人，王长乐知道自己必须要加速了，否则怪物宝贝被主角枪杀，他一切的谋划都要泡汤。
湖畔广场，叶钟鸣一个侧身躲过闪过的流光，看着不远处断手的怪物宝贝，和突然出现的三人组。
和原本时间线不同的是，伤势完全恢复的叶钟鸣，手中的锋月连斩隔开宛如银龙的长枪男，一拳将长枪男打飞。
忽然，一行军人带着枪械抵达现场，李舒俊顿时大叫着。
“王丁，就是那个怪物，快抢他后面的袋子！”
content_en:
,,!
Seeing Ye Zhongming looking at him seriously, he knew that he had been too radical just now and aroused the other party's suspicion.
I have to sigh, as expected, the person who can become the protagonist has intelligence that is always online.
Even before they grow up, it's not that simple. At least their minds are different from ordinary people.
"First, I have no ill intentions towards you, and second, I saved you twice, and the recovery item you are holding now is also mine.
You point a gun at me, okay? "
Looking at the other person with a smile, Wang Changle wanted to test whether this person was the same as the one in the setting. This was very important for his subsequent planning.
"This is not the place to talk. After the battle, I will go find you, Ye Zhongming, Boss Ye."
Hearing this, Ye Zhongming slowly put down his gun. He felt relieved and made a proposal.
"You really know me!
OK, I'll wait for you. "
When Ye Zhongming saw the young man in front of him who seemed sure that he did not dare to shoot, a fire ignited in his heart. This feeling of losing control made him annoyed!
The essence of life turned into a stream of light and sank into Ye Zhongming's body. Within a moment, all the injuries on his body were healed.
After looking at Wang Changle with complicated eyes, he strode out of the mall.
After spending all his efforts, he finally collected the sharp horns and part of the flesh.
He glanced at the extras who were rolling around on the ground but didn't dare to make any wailing noises, and he thoughtfully threw a loudspeaker.
"Help, help, come and save me!"
The loud cry for help echoed in the shopping mall, spreading far and wide, and also attracted many zombies.
For a time, screams mixed with calls for help could be heard.
Killing the enemy's hope is the greatest protection for yourself, no matter how weak the enemy is!
Looking at the chain prisoners nearly 50 meters in the distance, they were being attacked with rocket launchers. He immediately knew that he had spent too much time and missed the best ambush point.
Based on the feedback from the plants, he quickly determined the direction and rushed towards the lakeside square without stopping.
That's where the final battle will take place, and it will also be his last chance!
Under the impact of zombies and monsters, the power of the army's guns and artillery was maximized, and the firepower covered the monsters' activity radius.
At the same time, it also greatly restricted his travel route.
In order to avoid monsters and fire points to ensure his own safety, he had to take a long way around.
Looking at the green flame monster and the fighting water man in the distance, Wang Changle knew that he had to speed up, otherwise the monster baby would be shot dead by the protagonist, and all his plans would be ruined.
In the lakeside square, Ye Zhongming ducked sideways to avoid the flash of light and looked at the monster baby with a severed hand not far away and the trio that suddenly appeared.
Different from the original timeline, Ye Zhongming, who had fully recovered from his injuries, used the Fengyue Continuous Slash in his hand to separate the spear man who looked like a silver dragon, and knocked the spear man away with one punch.
Suddenly, a group of soldiers arrived at the scene with firearms, and Li Shujun suddenly shouted.
"Wang Ding, that's the monster, grab the bag behind him!"
